title: What's New: AL Go for GitHub (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to AL Go for GitHub
Code signing and HSM key storage
Custom deployment mechanism and on-premises support
Pull request status check and GitHub branch protection
Compiler folder and Linux runner architecture
Cost implications and GitHub minutes calculation
Customizing AL Go for GitHub with templates

features.name: AL Go for GitHub DevOps solution
features.description: A plug-and-play DevOps solution for Business Central development on GitHub that enables secure CI/CD, quality assurance, change tracking, and code validation without requiring knowledge of Docker, PowerShell, or YAML.

features.name: Settings configuration types
features.description: AL Go for GitHub supports three levels of settings: repository-wide settings covering template URL, schedules, runners, and environments; project-wide settings placed in .algo folders; and workflow-specific settings for test operations.

features.name: Version tracking in AL Go
features.description: AL Go version is specified in the template URL branch (main or preview) and displayed in initialize workflow output. Current version shown is 3.2.

features.name: Update AL Go system files workflow
features.description: A workflow that upgrades AL Go to the latest version. The check for updates job monitors for available updates and recommends running this workflow when new versions are available. Can also point to indirect template repositories for centralized customization management.
caveats: Requires a secret called GH token workflow with personal access token permissions
If settings already exist in the repository settings file, they will not be overwritten

features.name: HSM key storage for code signing
features.description: Support for code signing with private keys stored in hardware security modules or HSM key storage, including Azure Key Vault HSM. This addresses the July 1st requirement for code signing certificate providers to deliver private keys in hardware modules.
caveats: No demo available due to lack of code signing certificate

features.name: GitHub environments deployment
features.description: Support for deploying to GitHub environments with branch policies and environment-specific configurations. Includes ability to exclude certain environments from deployment.
caveats: Environments not available in private repositories in free GitHub tier

features.name: Deploy to environment configuration
features.description: New setting called deploy to environment name (e.g., deploy to QA) that replaces secret-based environment naming. Includes options for environment type, branches, projects, sync mode, and continuous deployment flag.

features.name: Continuous deployment to production environments
features.description: Ability to explicitly set continuous deployment to true or false regardless of environment type, allowing continuous deployment to production environments like final acceptance test environments.

features.name: Custom deployment mechanism
features.description: Feature allowing users to specify custom environment types (on-prem, custom, etc) and provide custom PowerShell scripts for deployment, enabling deployment to non-SaaS environments.
caveats: Custom deployment scripts not provided by Microsoft
ALOps external deployer module may help with on-premises deployments

features.name: Custom GitHub runner support
features.description: Optional ability to use a custom GitHub runner inside a firewall at a customer site for deployment to on-premises environments.
caveats: Optional
Requires GitHub runner infrastructure at customer site

features.name: Pull request status check job
features.description: New dedicated job for pull request validation that can be used as a required status check in GitHub branch protection rules, replacing the need to reference complex CI/CD workflow matrix jobs.

features.name: Compiler folder feature
features.description: New functionality that allows AL Go to build applications without containers and enables GitHub to cache artifacts, supporting faster Linux-based builds.
caveats: Currently requires manual setting configuration
Do not publish apps setting disables test running

features.name: Linux runner build optimization
features.description: Configuration to run entire CI/CD workflow on GitHub hosted Linux runners instead of Windows, reducing costs and improving build speed through compiler folder feature. Building AL Go apps on Linux GitHub runners without Docker containers achieves faster build times by eliminating container download and creation overhead.
caveats: Requires do not publish apps and use compiler folder settings
Test running disabled with do not publish apps setting
Requires use of compiler folder
Requires using Ubuntu GitHub runner

features.name: Business Central artifact caching
features.description: Caching Business Central artifacts locally on runners to avoid re-downloading them on subsequent builds, reducing build time from 4 minutes 42 seconds to 3 minutes 38 seconds.
caveats: Benefit only applies on subsequent builds after initial cache
Cache used with GitHub cache mechanism

features.name: Use GH token workflow feature
features.description: Checkbox option to use GH token workflow for pull requests and commits to overcome GitHub token limitations that prevent workflows from triggering other workflows.
caveats: Requires GitHub actions setting to allow actions to create and approve pull requests
Only works for pull requests and commits

features.name: BCPT test result viewer
features.description: Feature to view performance test results in CI/CD workflow summary, supporting baseline comparison and regression detection for performance and SQL statements.
caveats: Currently in draft pull request state
Test repository should be used for testing, not production
Feedback requested before final implementation

features.name: Customize AL Go for GitHub
features.description: Ability to customize AL Go for GitHub using template repositories to add custom jobs, settings, steps, and scripts to the CI/CD pipeline. Includes ability to add custom jobs like custom job/my job and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline with dependencies on build and other steps. Ability to add custom steps before the build, after the build, and before deploy steps with customization stored in indirect template repositories.
caveats: No promises on when this will be included
Requires understanding of template repository structure
Test repository use recommended before production

features.name: BC container partial script customization
features.description: Custom BC container partial script that can be created to customize container creation during test runs and can be part of indirect PTE templates.

features.name: Indirect template repository for AL Go
features.description: Feature allowing creation of a PTE indirect template repository that centralizes customizations and can be updated across multiple repositories using update AL Go system files.
caveats: Job merging behavior: jobs with same names are overwritten from template, new unique jobs are not overwritten

features.name: Custom job and step execution order
features.description: Custom jobs and steps from indirect template and repository are merged with defined execution order: template before steps run first, then repository before steps, then after steps (repository first, then template).
caveats: Jobs with same name from template overwrite repository versions
Unique jobs keep their original order

features.name: Fork alternative for AL Go customization
features.description: Forks of AL Go are mentioned as an alternative approach to creating custom template repositories, with no decision yet on which strategy to recommend.
caveats: No decision made on recommended approach
